items.question: What happens when the file has no Feature: line (empty or comment-only)?
items.ticket: raise a clear error on invalid files
items.chose: Throws a ParseError at line 1 saying a Feature: line is expected.
items.instead: Return an empty feature, or report the error at the last line of the file.

items.question: Is non-step text under a Feature, Background or Scenario header an error?
items.chose: Treats it as description and ignores it until the first step. After that, unrecognised lines throw.
items.instead: Reject any unrecognised line as invalid, or allow description text anywhere.

items.question: Are Scenario Outline, Scenario Template and Rule supported?
items.chose: Throws a ParseError saying they are not supported, at the line where they appear.
items.instead: Parse Scenario Outline like a Scenario, or skip those blocks.

items.question: How are Background steps returned, and what does an empty Background give?
items.chose: Stores the steps in a separate `feature.background` array, which is `[]` when empty and null when there is no Background. They are not merged into scenarios.
items.instead: Prepend the background steps to each scenario, or treat an empty Background as null.

items.question: Can a Background be repeated, carry tags, or come after a Scenario?
items.chose: Throws a ParseError for a second Background, for tags on a Background (reported at the first tag line), and for a Background after a Scenario.
items.instead: Allow tags and ignore them, or merge repeated Backgrounds.

items.question: What happens to tags, and where are they attached?
items.chose: Tags attach to the next Scenario only. Tags before Feature: are dropped. Dangling tags, or tags followed by a step, throw at the first tag line. A tag line holding non-tag words throws.
items.instead: Store feature tags on the feature, or ignore dangling tags silently.

items.question: Are tables and doc strings parsed, and how?
items.chose: Parses tables into trimmed cells with \|, \\ and \n escapes. Parses doc strings delimited by """ or ``` with the opening indent stripped. Both attach to the preceding step.
items.instead: Ignore tables and doc strings, or keep raw cell and line text without trimming or unescaping.

items.question: What if a step has both a table and a doc string, or either one has no preceding step?
items.chose: Throws a ParseError at the offending line.
items.instead: Allow both on one step, or ignore the orphan.

items.question: Where is an unclosed doc string reported?
items.ticket: Invalid files report the line of the error
items.chose: Reports the error at the line where the doc string opens, not at the end of the file.
items.instead: Report the last line of the file.

items.question: What happens to a step keyword with no text?
items.chose: Throws a ParseError, "a step needs text after its keyword".

items.question: What happens with a second Feature: line?
items.chose: Throws a ParseError at the second Feature: line.
items.instead: Start a new feature, or ignore the extra line.

items.question: How are keywords, step text and line endings handled?
items.chose: Keeps the keyword as written (And, But and * are not resolved to the previous Given/When/Then). Trims step text. Strips a trailing \r from CRLF lines. Skips # comment lines and blank lines.
items.instead: Resolve And/But/* to the preceding keyword, or keep trailing whitespace and treat \r as content.
